title: Create Liteweight
description: A lightweight create modpack designed for performance
body:
Create Liteweight is designed to be optimised for performance, with create being such a resource-heavy mod.
**Mods:**
- Create
- Create: Copycats+
- Curios API
- Cloth Config API
- Entity Culling
- Ferrite Core
- ImmediatelyFast
- Iris & Oculus Flywheel Compat
- Iris Shaders
- Just Enough Items (JEI)
- Lithium
- ModernFix
- More Culling
- Mouse Tweaks
- Reese's Sodium Options
- Shulker Box Tooltip
- Sodium
- Sodium Dynamic Lights
- Sodium Extra
- Xaero's Minimap
- Xaero's Worldmap
